summary: Plan for the Controller web UI modernization: token sheet, flat brand surfaces, header Actions menu replacing the menubar, collapsed task strip, off-canvas tree, operator labels, console focus mode and dark theme, with square status badges retained by owner decision.

guide.reason: Plan only; the guide pages it names change with the implementation tasks and their own record.

api.reason: Presentation-only plan; every task reuses the existing client-facing reads and writes unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Evolves the 2026-09-09 desktop layout plan without changing any phase or acceptance-gate status.

state.reason: Planning document; the plan itself commits to no Controller or Core state changes.

verification.method: python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. The plan's token contrast values were computed from the listed hex pairs on 2026-09-23; its screen findings come from an inspected capture set of every Controller view against a working-tree build with a labeled simulated inventory (captures not committed).
